title: Kissed Veracruz Tagliatelle Birria
description: A light, earth‑rich birria inspired pasta that marries tagliatelle with smoky chipotle jackfruit and tangy nuka‑pickle for a satvik-friendly twist.
instructions: Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil and cook the tagliatelle until al dente, about 8 minutes, then drain and set aside.
In a skillet, heat the olive oil over medium heat and add the shredded jackfruit, stirring until lightly browned.
Pour in the tomato sauce and coconut milk, then add the chipotle powder, cumin, and salt; bring to a simmer and let the sauce thicken for 5 minutes.
Fold in the cooked tagliatelle and the nuka‑pickle pieces, stirring to combine, and cook for an additional 2 minutes.
Remove from heat and adjust seasoning if needed.
Serve hot, garnished with a sprinkle of fresh cilantro.
Enjoy the aromatic, satvik-friendly birria twist on classic pasta.
Clean up the pan and utensils.
